parts.changeReason: V1.11 rear converter box, layout F (back-plate/layout-F/README.md): replaces the V1.10 layout C revision 2 frame and the printed V1.8 rear pack cover. The frame carries the exact cover outline, four cover holes and lip (x -47..-45) and a stepped box behind the pack with a square rim at x -59.1 and a constant cross-section, so the boards slide straight in from the rear: a wide tier |y| <= 32.05, z -15.2..43 with the two XL4015s horizontal (IN ends -y, OUT ends +y, as the kit photo and mesh show) and a narrow tier |y| <= 15.61, z -36.02..-15.2 with the Adafruit 5991 (terminal -y, USB-C +y). Closed bottom, side windows at each terminal, a USB-C slot in the +y wall, front passage P1 into the pack channel, eight XL4015 bosses (5.0 / 4.2 / 3.2 mm long, shell limited), four 5991 bosses on 3.0 mm standoffs, two cap screw bosses at (y -23.8, z -17.4) and (y +23.8, z -33.6), two tooth slots in the top wall and driver lanes for the two lower cover screws. Volume 10502.4 mm3, watertight, one body (layout-F/checks.json).

New V1.11 part: the rounded cap (x -67.1..-59.1, 1.2 mm walls) that closes the back of the layout F box and carries every rear-edge rounding (rear vertical edges R 7.4, rear top edge 7.8, step 4.3, narrow tier 4.5 / 8.0). Two tongues at the top corners run under the frame top wall with a tooth in a top-wall slot; two ears take M2 x 6 into the frame bosses at (y -23.8, z -17.4) and (y +23.8, z -33.6). Volume 6276.0 mm3, watertight (back-plate/layout-F/README.md).
